title: The muffler printout
logline: The muffler-shop printout pinned by Gully's door since 2006, yellowed, the page drawing it as a rectangle of light with the crab in one corner. What it says: reserved. That it's still up: the page.

panels.composition: A yellowed sheet of paper pinned by a shingle shack's door, its printing faded to gray blocks, a small crab drawn in one corner, the dock beyond.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a yellowed sheet of paper pinned beside a shingle shack's door with its printing faded to gray blocks and a small ink crab in one corner, a dock beyond, no words legible
image.notes: The muffler printout (objects.md · Gully's dock). Words reserved.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
